title: kubeconfig: values in exec plugin env and auth-provider config
summary: Whether the name and value pairs of exec.env and the entries of auth-provider.config in a kubeconfig users entry are secrets.
rationale: These maps are free-form: exec.env passes environment variables to a credential plugin and auth-provider.config is a string map. Either may hold an access token or only a harmless setting. The client-go types state neither, so an expectation would be a guess.

expectation.rationale: Left unresolved. The client-go types describe the maps (Env defines additional environment variables to expose to the process; AuthProviderConfig is a name and a string map) but do not say which entries are confidential. A provider statement, or a maintainer policy decision, would settle it.

sources.supports: ExecConfig.Env and AuthProviderConfig.Config are described without any statement of confidentiality.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.
